objective: Find controller gains that pass at least hard minimum gate (max ≤0.30m, final ≤0.10m)

torque_budget_analysis.diagnosis: Position term saturation is the TRUE LIMITER
torque_budget_analysis.recommendation: Safe to increase max_position_tau to 6-7 Nm

B.note: Identical to A - authority increase had no effect

C.note: Best 1000-step result, but too short to evaluate

comparison_to_baseline.conclusion: Modest improvement but still fails all gates. Increasing position gain was counterproductive.

failure_analysis.key_insight: Increasing k_position from 20.0 to 25.0 increased demanded torque from 10 Nm to 11 Nm, worsening saturation
failure_analysis.vicious_cycle: Higher gain → larger correction → hits saturation sooner → larger error → even larger demand

recommended_fixes.name: Substantial Authority Increase (Preferred)
recommended_fixes.rationale: Torque budget confirms 7.0 Nm is safe. Allows controller to apply demanded torque without saturation. Avoids aggressive gain.
recommended_fixes.risk: May increase aggressiveness, but torque budget has headroom

recommended_fixes.name: Add Integral Action
recommended_fixes.rationale: Eliminates steady-state bias. Reduces need for high proportional gain. Standard control technique.
recommended_fixes.risk: Integral windup during saturation - needs anti-windup

recommended_fixes.name: Combined Moderate Approach
recommended_fixes.rationale: Balanced increase in gain and authority. Reduced velocity damping frees ~0.5 Nm.
recommended_fixes.risk: May still saturate if demand exceeds 6.0 Nm
